## Commands run and their results

Record actual commands, results and evidence. In Stage 0 without an application,
typecheck / lint / test / build are not applicable and not run; never report them as passed.

## Acceptance checklist with pass or fail and evidence

- [ ] Identify the current stage and its exact completion criteria.
- [ ] List and verify each stage-specific criterion with evidence.
- [ ] Applicable typecheck, lint, test and build results recorded.
- [ ] No weakened tests or final acceptance criteria; deviations recorded.
- [ ] Scope, dependencies, accessibility and effect rules reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Human stage approval and independent H6 review remain separate gates.

### Stage 0 criteria

- [ ] Exactly the eight authorized governance paths are prepared.
- [ ] Complete A–H source archive and SHA-256 provenance recorded.
- [ ] D Box 1 and Box 2 preserved in order without outer fences.
- [ ] G2 rules retained, with authorized cloud/dots and Stage 0 clarification.
- [ ] F stage order and growth gates preserved.
- [ ] H1 summary (at most 20 lines), log, observations, proposals and decisions exist.
- [ ] Editor and ignore rules verified; whitespace results accurately reported.
- [ ] No scaffold, application, effect code, dependencies or build artifacts.
- [ ] Confirmed public author identity before commit; correct branch and remote verified.
- [ ] No merge or next stage; human approval awaited.
